name: Stopwatch
description: A flexible REDCap External Module that adds stopwatch widgets to data-entry forms and surveys. It can store elapsed time, captures, laps, and start/stop timestamps in several formats. For details and bug reports, see the module's GitHub page.

action-tags.description:
Turns a compatible field into a stopwatch widget, or writes the result to a separately configured target field. Customize the widget with a JSON parameter object:
@STOPWATCH=
{
  "parameter": "value"
}
See the module documentation for details and examples.
Adds a stopwatch that records multiple captures of elapsed time. Configure it in the same way as the @STOPWATCH action tag. See the module documentation for details and examples.
Adds a stopwatch that records multiple laps. Configure it in the same way as the @STOPWATCH action tag. See the module documentation for details and examples.
